subject: general
question: Vani walks from home to office. Starting from home, while going to office, he turned twice to the right and then to the left before reaching the office. If Bani was facing south when she reached her office, which direction did she face when she left her house?
solution:
Given: Bani walks from home to office. 

Starting from home, while going to office, 

Turned twice to the right.

and then to the left before reaching the office. 

Bani was facing south when she reached her office.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/434f0cb013ae52508dd638ab8e98906938b6a193f7c57a15498c65e3230cb433.png] 

So, Bani faces to the East direction while she left her house.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
